annotations.title: Send a follow-up instruction to a mission

description: Tell a mission what to change. Use kind='follow_up' (the default) to ask for a change: the instruction reaches the agents AND dispatches the builder against the mission's open pull request, overriding cached review and QA verdicts. Use kind='note' to record context for whatever runs next without starting any work. A restart is a different thing: it re-evaluates an unchanged pull request against its cached verdicts, and so changes nothing. Returns a receipt saying what was recorded and what it will cause. This tool calls the SHIP API, documented at https://letsship.ai/docs/api. Requires the missions:write token scope.

body.description: What the agents should do. Travels verbatim into the prompt

issueId.description: Issue id the mission is tracked under, e.g. SHIP-244 or GH-1280

kind.description: follow_up (default) dispatches the builder; note records context and dispatches nothing
